title: Discovery-layer audit: is the 248-candidate pool a measurement or an artefact?
executed_by: Claude (acting operator for this round, in place of Codex)
scope: Discovery layer only. No acquisition, no admission, no eligibility change, no extraction, no training.
motivation: R10 through R12B measured retrieval, extraction and classification.
R11's scarcity conclusion, R12's defect list and R12B's kappa were all computed over the same 248-candidate pool, which was never validated as representative.

findings.finding: acquire_license_verified_r10.py contains no pagination construct of any kind. No cursor, no cursorMark, no offset, no resumptionToken, no while loop. Every API is queried exactly once and truncated at its page-size literal.
findings.consequence: The candidate pool is capped at one page per query by construction, independent of how much the literature contains.

findings.finding: R10's own EUROPE_PMC_1 query, issued verbatim including its licence filter, addresses 10591 records. The sealed R10 manifest captured 79 candidates from it.
findings.consequence: 0.75% of the licence-filtered addressable pool reached the candidate set for the single largest query. The 248 pool is a bounded probe, not a sample of the literature.

findings.finding: The relevant() title-only keyword filter rejects 79.0% of records that have already passed both the licence filter and the subject query.

rejected_examples: Interaction Among Microbiota, Chemical Composition, and Quality Variations in Coffea arabica
Ohmic Fermentation Differentiates Volatile Fingerprints of Roasted Arabica and Robusta Coffees from Four Origins
Cross-Cultural Comparison of the Espresso Protocol Repeatability
Unlocking the Quality Potential of Liberoid Coffee: Advances in Composition, Processing, and Microbial Fermentation
Near-Infrared Spectroscopy-Based Discriminant Analysis for the Classification of Coffee Quality

findings.cause: The filter inspects the title only, and requires it to contain both a subject token (coffee|coffea) and a topic token (sensory|cupping|flavor|flavour|descriptive|cata|qda|aroma|taste). Papers whose titles use quality, volatile, fermentation, profile or protocol vocabulary are rejected regardless of content.
findings.consequence: Compounds multiplicatively with F1. Abstract and full-text content are never inspected.

findings.finding: The low Dryad yield is genuine scarcity, not a licence-parsing defect. Hypothesis tested and rejected.
findings.note: Recorded so this hypothesis is not re-tested in a later round.

findings.finding: The R10 acquisition script declares itself a bounded enhancement, not a primary acquisition, and the sealed manifest carries that declaration forward.

evidence.docstring: Run the bounded, license-filtered R10 discovery enhancement.

findings.consequence: R11, R12 and R12B treated the output of a self-declared bounded enhancement as the population under study. The scarcity conclusion inherits that scope error.

findings_mapping_layer.finding: The ontology/relational layer fails for a missing cell-tokenisation step, not for vocabulary coverage. The mapper receives each table cell as one atomic surface form.
findings_mapping_layer.cause: Multi-term odour-description cells are the standard reporting format for GC-O and descriptive sensory tables. A single-term rule can never match 'honey, sweet, floral, green', so the entire cell is queued as NO_FROZEN_R6_RULE even though honey, sweet and floral are all existing concepts. Only clean single entries map.
findings_mapping_layer.consequence: Relational and ontology data is extracted successfully and then discarded at integration. 70.2% of distinct rejected forms are multi-term; 58.0% contain at least one known descriptor root under a deliberately small 27-root vocabulary.

findings_mapping_layer.finding: The T5+T6 ontology surplus reported by R11 is not usable material. It is extraction volume that never reached the concept space.
findings_mapping_layer.consequence: Any architecture premised on an abundant governed ontology, including the Option C-fuzzy rule base, is blocked by the same defect. The premise that ontology material is the one thing in surplus is withdrawn.
findings_mapping_layer.supersedes: The R11 exit-criterion PASS on T5+T6 (1644/200) counts extraction, not admitted ontology.

verdict.question: Did R10-R12B measure the literature, or a bounded probe of it?
verdict.answer: A bounded probe. The 248-candidate pool is capped by a missing pagination construct and reduced further by a title-only filter that rejects 79% of already-qualified records.
what_is_not_established: This does NOT establish that sufficient sample-by-descriptor supervision exists.
Addressable hit count is not extractable supervision. Every record still faces retrieval, table detection, classification and gating, whose losses R12 and R12B measured but could not quantify.
No population supply estimate is made or implied. Inverse-ratio extrapolation from a capture ratio is not a supply estimator, consistent with the constraint recorded in r12/control_set.json.
what_is_established: The discovery layer is defective in two specific, independently confirmed ways (F1, F3).
Both defects are repairable without any change to eligibility rules, licence policy, or excluded-source lists.
The corpus size question has not yet been asked under a correct instrument.

execution_tokenised_remapping.action: Re-resolved all 1429 queued surface forms with list-fragment tokenisation, using the identical concept registry and the identical 42 frozen R6 rules that R11 used.
execution_tokenised_remapping.policy_position: Bug fix in the caller, not a policy change. Fragments resolve only under rules that already existed. Unresolved fragments remain queued.

second_defect_found.finding: load_direct_registry() admits only concept ids prefixed 'sensory.'. Concepts prefixed 'attribute.' and 'broad.' are unreachable except through an explicit R6 rule, and no rule exists for the bare surface forms of the project's own top-level dimensions.

evidence.note: floral and fruity are two of the nine declared support dimensions. attribute.fruity is reachable via rules elsewhere, proving the concept exists while its bare surface form cannot reach it.

owner_review_prioritisation.purpose: Converts an undifferentiated 1429-item queue into a bounded decision list ranked by fragment frequency.

limitations: Recovery counts resolved surface forms, not admitted supervision. Downstream extraction gates measured by R12/R12B still apply and remain unquantified.
No coffee group count is claimed; group formation was not run.
BROAD_CATEGORY_ONLY resolutions stay broad and are not promoted to specific descriptors.
The prioritisation curve estimates rule value, it does not author or approve any rule.

execution_gate_repair_shadow.action: Repaired five admission defects and re-ran the gate stack over the same frozen 248 candidates and the same cached full text. Sealed R11 artefacts untouched; nothing promoted.

repairs.G1: table_is_consumer scope: judge the table caption, or the absence of any professional-panel signal under a widened vocabulary, instead of scanning the whole article text
repairs.G2: TABLE_SUPERVISION_CUE: caption match OR at least two resolvable descriptor/dimension terms in the table content
repairs.G3: trust R10's already-resolved non-ND licence instead of demanding re-verification
repairs.G4: widen the descriptor-axis column window from row[:3]
repairs.G5: NEW GUARD, tightening: reject instrumental, chemical-solution, statistics, descriptor-as-sample and axis-header labels used as coffee samples

new_defect_exposed.finding: Table orientation error. 95 row labels on newly admitted tables are descriptor or dimension terms, not coffee samples, meaning transposed tables are read along the wrong axis.
new_defect_exposed.significance: This defect was invisible while the over-strict consumer switch was rejecting 44.6% of tables. Repairing G1 exposed it. An over-strict gate was masking a correctness bug rather than preventing it.
new_defect_exposed.status: Blocked by the new G5 guard in this shadow run; the underlying descriptor_axis orientation logic is not yet repaired.

value_of_recovered_material.note: Several clean newly admitted tables are exactly the context-contrast material whose coverage was previously 0.
examples: Washed / Natural / Washed + Natural processing contrast (three tables)
Light-4C-T2 through T5 roast-by-temperature conditions, 13 rows
Barely Soft / Hard+ / Hard / Hard- Brazilian sensory classification, 6 rows

limitations: Shadow measurement of gate behaviour only. No record was extracted, mapped, grouped, admitted or written to any corpus.
A table passing the repaired gates is not established supervision. Descriptor-axis resolution, sample identity and grouping still apply downstream.
The widened professional-panel vocabulary in G1 is a judgement about sensory methods reporting and should be reviewed before promotion.
F12 is contained by G5 in this run but not fixed at its source.
execution_gate_repair_shadow.reproducibility: Byte-identical across runs excluding the generated_at_utc field; no network access.

execution_orientation_diagnosis.action: Profiled both axes of every cached table and called descriptor_axis unmodified, to locate F12 at its source.

RETRACTION.claim_withdrawn: R12C-F12 as stated in execution_gate_repair_shadow: 'table orientation error, 95 row labels are descriptors'.
RETRACTION.cause_of_the_error: The figure of 95 came from the shadow script taking column 0 of every newly admitted table as the sample-label list. That is the author's own shortcut, not pipeline behaviour. The pipeline calls descriptor_axis, which selects an orientation and mostly selects it correctly.
RETRACTION.lesson: A defect measured through a proxy is not a defect of the system. The proxy was not the code under test.

real_finding.finding: 346 of 397 cached tables (87.2%) receive no descriptor-axis decision at all. This is the largest single loss point in the extraction stage, larger than any gate.

tokenisation_recovery.note: The F6 tokenisation defect also reaches descriptor_axis, but explains only about a tenth of the axis-less tables.

vocabulary_ceiling.finding: descriptor_axis requires two or more recognisable terms on one axis. The recognisable vocabulary is only 126 terms.
vocabulary_ceiling.IMPORTANT_LIMITATION: This 1892 figure must NOT be read as a sensory-vocabulary gap of that size. The most frequent unrecognised terms are chemistry, demographic and study-design vocabulary - age, caffeine, compound, concentration, content, gender, moisture, method, harvest period, green beans, formulation - not sensory descriptors. A large share of the 346 axis-less tables are genuinely not sensory tables and correctly receive no axis. This measurement cannot separate genuine vocabulary gaps from correct rejections, and no claim about the split is made.
vocabulary_ceiling.what_is_established: The recognisable vocabulary is 126 terms and is the binding ceiling on descriptor_axis. Discovery, gate and tokenisation repairs all deliver more material into a stage whose vocabulary ceiling has not moved.
vocabulary_ceiling.what_is_not_established: How many of the 346 axis-less tables contain real sensory supervision.

causal_chain_summary: Discovery defects (F1, F3) capped the candidate pool at one page per query and rejected 79% of qualified records on a title-only filter.
Admission gates (F6-class) rejected 71.9% of detected tables via wrong-granularity keyword tests, chiefly an article-level consumer switch that misfired on 35 of 36 professional papers.
The mapping layer (F6) discarded 1429 ontology forms for lack of list-fragment tokenisation; 515 are recoverable under existing rules.
Downstream of all three, descriptor_axis still yields nothing for 87.2% of tables, bounded by a 126-term recognisable vocabulary.

Vocabulary can only grow through owner-approved R6 rules. The prioritisation curve shows 60 approvals cover 73.3% of the queued forms. The owner review queue, not the literature, is the binding constraint.

execution_owner_review_sheet.action: Categorised the top 60 unresolved surface forms by the kind of authority approving each would require.
execution_owner_review_sheet.framing_correction: The earlier claim that 60 rule approvals lift recovery to 73.3% treated these as 60 equivalent decisions. They are not.

category_A_finding.finding: Seven of the highest-frequency unresolved forms - sweet, fruity, floral, sour, roasted, flowery, acid - are already members of NATIVE_DIMENSIONS. They appear unresolved only because resolve_surface never consults NATIVE_DIMENSIONS while dimension_surface does.
category_A_finding.consequence: Two functions in the same module disagree about what vocabulary exists. 302 of roughly 1090 ranked fragment occurrences are recoverable with zero owner decisions.

category_C_structure.observation: The 46 judgement items are not 46 independent decisions. They cluster into a small number of policy questions.

clusters.question: Does the concept space admit defect and off-flavour terms?
Is mouthfeel and texture in scope, or only flavour percepts?
Straightforward flavour terms with no existing concept

noise_item.note: parsing artefact, not a term; should be dropped rather than decided

execution_owner_review_sheet.editorial_disclosure: The NOT_A_FLAVOUR_DESCRIPTOR membership (fresh, coffee, clean, mild) is an explicit editorial judgement by the audit author, recorded so the owner can contest any member.

reproducibility.PROBE: Point-in-time live API observations. Hit counts drift as indexes update. Each probe records its query, retrieval timestamp and response digest.

owner_scope_decision.summary: Owner ruled on concept-space scope: defects admitted as low-weight attachments to parent flavours; mouthfeel bound to C0/C1 context inference; roast information and coffee kind promoted to first-class; chemical classes excluded; rejected terms retained rather than discarded.
